title: Transfer to a registered reverse distributor
rule_summary: A registrant may transfer controlled substances to a DEA-registered reverse distributor under the applicable inventory, ordering, transfer, and record requirements.
exam_relevance: Tests whether the candidate can apply reverse distribution requirements to a pharmacy-practice scenario without substituting a nearby rule.

authority.name: Transfer to a registered reverse distributor

exceptions: Apply any narrower setting-specific, product-specific, or emergency exception before the general rule.
common_confusions: Confusing reverse distribution with a nearby rule that has a different trigger or deadline.
